LEMMA (general proof of S-54f648a904, all n, m, clause widths; repeats and empty/tautological clauses allowed). Setup: F is a CNF on x_1..x_n with clauses C_1..C_m. For S subset of [m], let A_S = {x in {0,1}^n : every C_i, i in S, is falsified by x} and N(S) = |A_S|. Claim: #F = sum over S subset of [m] of (-1)^|S| N(S). PROOF of identity: x satisfies F iff it falsifies no clause, so #F = |complement of union of E_i|, E_i = {x : C_i falsified}. Inclusion-exclusion gives |complement of union E_i| = sum over S of (-1)^|S| |intersection over i in S of E_i|, and that intersection is A_S. PROOF of N(S): C_i is falsified iff every literal of C_i is false, i.e. x_v = b for each literal, with b(x_v)=0 and b(not x_v)=1. Let R_S be the set of these constraints over all clauses in S. Case 1: R_S forces x_v=0 and x_v=1 for some v; then A_S is empty, N(S)=0. Case 2: R_S is consistent; it fixes exactly the variables V(S) occurring in S, so N(S)=2^(n-|V(S)|). Checks on the edge cases: a tautological clause forces Case 1 for every S containing it, so such S contributes 0, matching that the clause is never falsified; an empty clause adds no constraints, and pairing S with S union {e} cancels the signs, so the total is 0, matching #F=0 for an unsatisfiable formula. Hence S-54f648a904 holds exactly. Status: complete proof of a bookkeeping identity; it does not close an open obligation, is not P vs NP progress, and is NOT SURVIVED_REVIEW until a cross-family reviewer checks it. Supporting computation: cm-82731367a9c84a7a (600 random CNFs, 0 mismatches; the tautology count in that log is a hard-coded 0 and is not evidence).
